g.text: - Dynamic horizontal scaling with queue: we

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: add submission to queue-> worker take-up -> on completion notifies app server to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: update the status. One important thing to note is that the introduction of the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: queue has made the system asynchronous. This means that the API server will no

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: longer be able to return the results of the submission immediately. Instead, the user

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: will need to poll the server for the results. We introduce a new endpoint, say GET

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: /check/:id, that is polled every second by the client to check if the submission has

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: been processed. It simply looks up the submission in the database and returns the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: results if they are available or returns a "processing" message if not.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A proposed solution is to run only about 10% of test cases during the contest,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: showing participants partial scores in real time. After the contest ends, organizers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: can run all submissions on the full set of test cases to produce final, official results.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This approach reduces infrastructure costs, though it delays final standings—similar

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to how Codeforces manages its large-scale contests.
